projects.title: SentinelFlow
projects.description: An AI Agent Security Gateway. Agents may propose tool calls. A deterministic policy engine in the backend decides ALLOW, BLOCK, or REQUIRE_APPROVAL. Mock tools run only after ALLOW. The HTTP API never trusts a client-supplied decision.
